report.summary: daedalus/eval/graph_delta.py: Measures whether multi-layer graph deltas (AST identifiers, literals, structure, types, data literals) can detect defects that test suites miss, using a mutation corpus from tools/gate_discrimination.py and a real-commit baseline for specificity.
risks: CLAIMS|daedalus/eval/graph_delta.py|'The claim under test here is that the layered graph carries a second, independent signal: For a candidate patch, does the DELTA IN THE GRAPH carry information about the patch that the test suite does not — available before the tests run, at negligible cost?'
SMELL|daedalus/eval/graph_delta.py|Similar flattening of Counter to set in _literal_keys, _structure_keys, _ast_refs; could be abstracted.
todos: daedalus/eval/graph_delta.py|constant|DELTA_VERSION|Identifies the version of the delta measurement ('1').
daedalus/eval/graph_delta.py|function|load_mutations|Imports the mutation corpus from tools/gate_discrimination.py without copying.
daedalus/eval/graph_delta.py|class|LayerDelta|Represents what moved in one layer (added/removed names).
daedalus/eval/graph_delta.py|class|DeltaResult|Aggregates mutation measurement with detection status and layers.
daedalus/eval/graph_delta.py|function|measure|Applies one mutation in memory and reports deltas per layer.
daedalus/eval/graph_delta.py|function|run|Runs the measurement over all mutations and returns aggregated results.
daedalus/eval/graph_delta.py|function|main|CLI wrapper that runs measurement and writes JSON evidence.

handoff.suggestion: The file defines commit_shas, measure_commit, and _git but they are currently unwired (no caller in this file). They likely support a specificity arm that is not yet integrated. Consider either wiring them into run() or removing them to avoid dead code.
